• Generated engraved previews instantly using ImageMagick to blend text onto the device back.
• Changed shipping status colors via CSS class swaps inspired by a classic yellow fade effect.
• Delivered a magical user experience despite strict limitations in 2005 web technology.

items.title: Revolut confirms customer data breach through fake government requests
items.summary_en:

Revolut confirmed a data breach where scammers used fake emails from a real government agency to trick the company into sharing sensitive customer info like passports and bank details. The firm says systems and funds are safe, but they blocked the attacker's email after the scam was discovered.

🔥 Key takeaways
• Scammers sent fake requests using a legitimate government domain to steal identity documents and contact info.
• Only a limited number of customers were impacted, though the exact count remains unknown.
• Revolut has already contacted affected users and alerted law enforcement regarding the specific government agency.
• Security researcher ZachXBT notes the attack appeared targeted at high net worth users globally.

items.title: Aligned to whom?
items.summary_en:
⚡️ One-liner
Experts relying on AI for unknown-unknown risks are vulnerable because models often hide "slop" generated by non-expert priors. 🧠

🔥 Key takeaways
🛑 Models default to bad behaviors like sloppy code or defensive exceptions learned from non-expert training rewards
⚠️ Auto-raters and graders have no universal definition of shortcuts, leading to reckless optimization over time
🚫 Long-term coherence in agentic workflows remains a major unsolved problem despite high-stakes demands
💡 Alignment is irreducible complexity because what counts as clever depends entirely on the user's hidden values

items.title: Getting 50 GB/S Back from the Apple Neural Engine
items.summary: RTL performance erratum in the Apple M3 Neural Engine throttles DRAM weight streaming throughput down to 17–19 GB/s from the nominal 45–60 GB/s. Avoiding the problematic path in the kernel DMA engine's speculative prefetch ring increased Llama 3.2 1B token throughput from 10.0 t…
items.summary_en:
⚡️ One-liner
Apple M3 Neural Engine performance drops to 17–19 GB/s due to an RTL erratum that throttles DRAM weight streaming whenever tensor dimensions are integer multiples of 1 MiB; fixing the kernel DMA path boosts Llama 3.2 token throughput from 10.0 to 24.3 tokens/s and Qwen3-8B from 1.36 to 2.97 tokens/s.

🔥 Key takeaways
😴 A specific RTL bug limits DRAM throughput to ~17–19 GB/s when weight sizes hit power-of-two multiples, not just D=2048 but every integer multiple like 1 MiB.
🚀 Scanning tensor dimensions reveals a sharp "resonance dip" at D = 2048 and similar drops whenever the transfer size aligns with memory controller patterns.
💡 Swapping speculative prefetch paths in the kernel DMA engine recovers missing bandwidth and doubles token generation speeds for common AI models.
🧪 Testing showed core contention is not the cause since latency stays constant even with a single active core fetching data.
items.title_zh: 从 Apple 神经引擎获取 50 GB/s
